experiments.name: Historical moving-average baseline
experiments.description: Uses lag_7_avg directly as the demand prediction.

experiments.name: Deterministic XGBoost baseline
experiments.description: Uses the shared S2 forecast-time feature contract with a deterministic XGBoost point forecast objective.

experiments.name: Tweedie Q50 with conformal interval
experiments.description: Uses the shared S2 forecast-time feature contract with a Tweedie Q50 point forecast and conformal prediction interval.

candidate_experiments.name: Log-scale quantile candidate
candidate_experiments.description: Trains Q10/Q50/Q90 quantile models on log1p quantity and evaluates outputs in demand units.
candidate_experiments.validation_design: chronological train/validation fit with chronological holdout test set

candidate_experiments.name: Demand-scale conformal candidate
candidate_experiments.description: Calibrates conformal half-width by predicted demand scale while keeping the deployed Q50 model fixed.
candidate_experiments.validation_design: validation residual calibration with chronological holdout test set

candidate_experiments.name: Relative conformal candidate
candidate_experiments.description: Calibrates interval width using normalized residuals while keeping the deployed Q50 model fixed.
candidate_experiments.validation_design: validation normalized-residual calibration with chronological holdout test set

supplementary_experiments.name: Auxiliary high-demand risk classifier
supplementary_experiments.description: Classifies product-day high-demand risk using the shared 27-feature forecast-time contract. Metrics are classification signals and are not directly comparable with WAPE.

supplementary_experiments.name: Weekly event-aware supplementary forecast
supplementary_experiments.description: Forecasts weekly product demand with reserved new-product and competitor event fields for supplementary scenario analysis.

paper_claim.claim: S2 improves from a simple historical baseline to a deterministic machine-learning baseline, then adds calibrated uncertainty for downstream production and inventory decisions.
